root_cause.text: Incorrect use of `sizeof(phys_addr_t *)` instead of `sizeof(phys_addr_t)` in the `krealloc()` call within `__efi_capsule_setup_info()`, causing undersized reallocation of the `cap_info->phys` array and a potential heap buffer overflow when storing physical addresses.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff changes `sizeof(phys_addr_t *)` to `sizeof(phys_addr_t)` in `krealloc()` at line 70 of `drivers/firmware/efi/capsule-loader.c`. The CVE description and commit message explicitly state that this mismatch leads to half-sized allocation on 32-bit systems with PAE (where `phys_addr_t` is 64-bit but pointers are 32-bit), inconsistent with the initial allocation using `sizeof(phys_addr_t)` and the actual usage of `page_to_phys()` which returns `phys_addr_t`.
